About Rockfon Sonar®

Rockfon Sonar offers optimal acoustic performance with NRC up to 0.95, panel CAC up to 35, and system CAC up to 58, in our widest array of sizes and edge types. The elegant, matte finish elevates the aesthetics of interior spaces, while delivering the performance benefits of stone wool. Rockfon Sonar acoustical ceiling tiles are Certified UL GREENGUARD Gold supported by EPD, HPD, and Declare Label and manufactured with GWP as low as 0.325 kg CO2 – eq/ft2 / 3.49 kg CO2 – eq/m2.

Premium smooth surface, modern aesthetics. Widest range of edge styles and sizes.

Frequently Asked Questions



How are ceiling tiles & panels installed?

You can trust that stone wool ceiling panels and tiles will perform with Chicago Metallic grid from Rockfon. We offer installation guides, how to cut stone wool tiles and panels, and more to help you along the way.



Are stone wool tiles and panels heavy?

You might think that stone wool ceiling tiles are heavy, since they are made with stone wool. Due to the unique properties of stone wool, the panels are lightweight and as easy to install as other products across the industry.



How long do ceiling panels & tiles last?

We’re proud of our 30-year warranty on stone wool ceiling tiles and panels. You can be sure we offer the best warranty in the industry with stone wool products.



What are ceiling tiles made of?

Builders and contractors have many options for ceiling tiles, including paper-based, wet-felted mineral fiber, and fiberglass. Rockfon ceiling tiles and panels are manufactured with stone wool – or whipped basalt rock – creating gorgeous, affordable ceiling tiles.



Do acoustical soundproof ceiling tiles work?

Acoustical ceiling tiles are for sound absorption and work to support a fully soundproof solution. Interested in discovering more about soundproofing? Explore insulation options from [ROCKWOOL](https://www.rockwool.com/).



How do you optimize a ceiling for sound absorption?

The [Optimized Acoustics approach](https://www.rockfon.com/en-us/products/product-benefits/acoustics/) takes into consideration how the right combination of highly absorptive stone wool or metal ceiling panels, robust walls and floor slabs, and background sound work together to optimize the acoustics in a room.



What makes stone wool an optimal material for ceiling tiles?

Stone wool has an open, porous structure, which makes Rockfon ceiling tiles and panels highly efficient [sound absorbers](https://www.rockfon.com/en-us/products/product-benefits/acoustics/acoustic-absorption/) by nature. The Acoustical Society of America found that in schools with no sound absorption, children miss 25% of words spoken by their teachers.



Where can I find Rockfon stone wool acoustic ceiling tiles and panels?

We partner with distributors across North America to provide customers with stone wool ceiling tiles and panels, metal ceilings, and Chicago Metallic grid systems. Visit our [Contact Us page](https://www.rockfon.com/en-us/contact-us/) to find one near you.
